info.title: RIG Intelligence API
info.description:
Read API over your provisioned intelligence scope — news articles, newspaper cuttings, and YouTube — with directed sentiment, grouped stories, geography, briefings, and programmatic control of your own coverage scope.

Authenticate with your key as `Authorization: Bearer rig_live_…` (or `X-API-Key`). Your key encodes your organisation and scope; every response is filtered to it.
info.x-confidential: Partner integration reference — not for redistribution.
